title: Capability Token
description: Short-lived, scoped, intent-bound permission token granting an agent access to a specific tool and resource.

token_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the canonicalized token fields.

agent_id.description: Agent this token is issued to.

intent_hash.description: Intent contract this token is bound to.

capability.description: The specific tool action this token permits (e.g. email.read).

resource.description: The specific resource this token grants access to.

max_uses.description: Maximum number of times this token can be used.

signature.description: Ed25519 signature of the token fields by the issuer (base64-encoded).
